reason: I'm a small contractor on houses and small blocks. Glazing damage before handover is the glazing subcontractor's problem, not mine, so I have no budget line for this. I'm not paying €19 a m² on top of my costs for something a sub should cover.
objection: Why would I pay to protect someone else's glazing? If the subcontractor wants it, he can buy it and put it in his price.
instead: Leave it to the glazing subcontractor, who covers the frames with tape or film himself, and clean up before handover.
would_change_my_mind: If my glazing sub offered it inside his quote at no extra cost to me, or if a client demanded it in writing, I would accept it. I still wouldn't buy it myself.
